reconcileDrift: The first UI handoff now compiles, but its own blocker is still present: production App uses a local placeholder SproutPaceRoot and static sample content instead of the Decompose AppRootComponent, active ScreenComponent model and confirmation slot. Existing visual design/resources/previews are preserved.
goal: Replace the placeholder production root with a real Decompose AppRootComponent adapter: subscribe to active stack/model and confirmation slot, render actual model items/states, route navigation/back/retry/commands to root and ScreenComponent, keep previews explicitly preview-only, and make iOS MainViewController require the same production root instance.
acceptanceCriteria: Production App accepts AppRootComponent and contains no placeholder production root or ignored root instance.
Active ChildStack ScreenComponent.model and confirmation ChildSlot drive rendered screen, variants, items, selection, busy/offline/ad flags and destructive confirmation.
Navigation, back, retry, selection and executable UI commands route to AppRootComponent or active ScreenComponent without stringly duplicated navigation state.
Preview entry points remain deterministic and never create the production root.
iOS MainViewController requires the caller-provided AppRootComponent used by Compose.
Executable mapping/action tests cover all sixteen ScreenId values and primary navigation.
No domain, persistence or product-scope changes; specialist does not run Gradle or edit ledger.
